fields.DESCRIPTION: This exquisite brass serving tray set is the perfect blend of style and tradition. Featuring a beautifully detailed tray with matching bowls and a serving spoon, this set is ideal for serving snacks, tea, or desserts in a luxurious manner. The elegant brass finish adds a touch of sophistication to any occasion, whether it's a festive celebration, a family gathering, or a formal dinner. The intricate design on the tray makes it not only functional but also a piece of art that enhances your home decor. Perfect for gifting or as a timeless addition to your kitchenware collection.
